structuredContent.description: One small hostile eclipse magic projectile for a dark fantasy pixel-art survivors game, travelling horizontally EAST. A compact hooked crescent of spectral cold mint energy wrapped around a dark blue-slate core, two short swept-back wisps. Strong coarse pixel clusters and stepped edges, sparse flat shading, a single narrow pale-mint rim highlight; modest miniboss attack, no bloom or blur. Not an arrowhead or purple rune shard, not a skull, not a glyph circle, not a huge fireball. Use the reference armored Eclipse caster ONLY as palette and pixel-style reference, do not draw the character. One isolated projectile only on transparent canvas. Head/pivot at x92 y64 on 128x128 canvas. Visible design contained between x32..104 y44..84, a short tapering left tail, generous transparent margins on every side. Restrained dark slate/teal/mint palette, very limited pale highlight area, no pure-white mass, no warm colors, no purple, no lightning/web/particles filling the canvas, no background, no floor, no text.
